derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree;

occurrences.text: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.
